working: Let side = s cm, volume V = s³ cm³. When 800 g is on the cube, the cube is fully submerged: ρ_cube V + 800 = ρ_water V. Thus ρ_cube = ρ_water – 800/V. After removing the mass, 2 cm of the cube is above water, so the submerged volume is V – 2s². Buoyancy gives ρ_water (V – 2s²) = ρ_cube V. Substituting ρ_cube gives ρ_water V – 2ρ_water s² = (ρ_water – 800/V)V = ρ_water V – 800. Cancelling ρ_water V yields –2ρ_water s² = –800. With ρ_water = 1 g/cm³, 2s² = 800 ⇒ s² = 400 ⇒ s = 20 cm.
